description: This file defines a Java interface named CustomerOptionSetService, which specifies methods for managing CustomerOptionSet entities, including saveOrUpdate and various list retrieval methods based on store, option, or option value.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a CustomerOptionSet entity, throwing a ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: listByOption
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific customer option and store.

methods.name: listByOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific customer option value and store.
